privateOwnerReceiptBridge.businessSignal: Private production approvals can be represented as owner, alias, redaction policy, public reference, and state without copying receipt bodies into public evidence.

cutoverSignoffDiff.businessSignal: Reviewer-visible signoff deltas preserve accepted, changed, and requested states instead of narrating production readiness as a single gate.

productionRouteShadowReplay.businessSignal: Route shadow replay mirrors receipt state and command intent while keeping endpoint resolution and live writes outside the public package.

guardrails: Private receipt aliases can be referenced, but private values and receipt bodies cannot be embedded.
Owner-held endpoint route and route unfreeze approvals keep the cutover gate in Review.
Shadow replay cannot promote watch or owner-held routes even when public lanes pass.
Any private value exposure or non-zero live write blocks the package.
